newsitem.title: USA: Henry Schein acquires medical supplier.
newsitem.headline: Henry Schein acquires medical supplier.

text.p: Henry Schein Inc said it has acquired Delta Scientific Inc, a privately-held distributor of office-based physician laboratory equipment and supplies.
The company said it expects to post a non-recurring charge related to the acquisition in 1997. It did not specify the level of the expected charge.
In addition, the company said it expects the acquisition of Delta Scientific, which had 1996 sales of more than $7 million, to be accretive to 1997 earnings.
Henry Schein is a direct marketer of healthcare products and services to office-based healthcare practitioners.
